content:
![save earl](../../uploads/blog/2009/06/saveearl.jpg "save earl")

Since [My Name is Earl was canceled in the EUA](https://parade.com/97056/parade/my-name-is-earl-canceled/ "MNIE canceled"), lots of fans started to create several petitions for the series to go on, which in my opinion is one of the funniest. If you think [My Name is Earl](http://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Name_is_Earl "MNIE on Wikipédia") should continue, to your little quota e start following [EarlTwitition](http://twitter.com/EarlTwitition "EarlTwitition") profile on [Twitter](http://twitter.com/ "Official website"). It's a fact that big companies are always looking after blogs and [Twitters](http://twitter.com/invitations/find_on_twitter "Users on Twitter"), who knows this can work out?

**Source:** [popwatch.ew.com/](http://popwatch.ew.com/popwatch/2009/05/earl-fans-start.html "My Name is Earl Twitition")
